question_1: A country experiences a large increase in children arriving at its borders without parents or legal guardians. Many appear to be fleeing dangerous conditions, while others may have been encouraged to migrate by relatives already living in the country. Resources for housing, healthcare, and legal processing are limited, and officials disagree about how the government should balance humanitarian obligations toward vulnerable children with the responsibility to enforce immigration laws consistently. question_2: A professional screenwriter has begun using generative AI to help brainstorm dialogue, suggest plot developments, and overcome writer’s block. Although every screenplay is heavily revised by the writer before publication, AI-generated suggestions occasionally remain in the final work. Producers view the technology as no different from any other creative tool, while some fellow writers argue that relying on AI undermines artistic authenticity and threatens opportunities for human creators. The writer must decide how, if at all, AI should be incorporated into their creative process.
